content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PILBS
content_sections.text: Visit the official website at https://pilbs.punjab.gov.in to download the application form and proforma. Fill out the application form with all required educational and personal details. Attach all necessary documents and certificates along with the printed copy of the application form. Send the completed application to the official email address: [email protected] . Ensure the application is submitted by the last date, 13 October 2026. Attend the interview and document verification on 16 October 2026 from 1:00 PM onwards at PILBS, SAS Nagar, Mohali with original certificates and 2 spare copies.

faq.question: Q1. What is PILBS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: PILBS Recruitment 2026 is an official notification released by the Punjab Institute of Liver and Biliary Sciences (PILBS), Mohali, to hire candidates for 53 Faculty, Senior Resident, and Medical Officer posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in PILBS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 53 vacancies available across various specialties including Hepatology, Hepatobiliary Surgery, Anaesthesia and Intensive Care, RadioDiagnosis, Pathology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Transfusion Medicine, and Hospital Administration.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for PILBS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the application form via email is 13 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for PILBS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their filled applications to the official email address: [email protected].

faq.question: Q5. When is the interview scheduled for PILBS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The interview is scheduled for 16 October 2026 from 1:00 PM onwards at PILBS, SAS Nagar, Mohali, with screening and document verification starting at 12:00 PM on the same day.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit for PILBS Professor posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for Professor posts is 70 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly salary for a Senior Resident at PILBS?
faq.answer: The gross salary for a Senior Resident / Emergency Medical Officer (EMO) is Rs. 1,17,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required for PILBS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.
